children: Grayscale Bittensor Trust expanded and updated its custody arrangements for TAO. The Trust joined BitGo’s amended and restated custodial services agreement, under which BitGo remains the primary custodian holding segregated assets with insurance coverage and fork-handling discretion. The Trust also added Coinbase as an additional custodian via the Coinbase Prime Broker Agreement, enabling allocation of a portion of TAO to Coinbase’s segregated accounts and cold storage workflows. In connection with the update, the Trust terminated its 2025 BitGo custodial agreement; custody now operates under the amended BitGo framework and the new Coinbase arrangement.
